title: Extremal middle Hodge numbers of smooth complex Grassmannian hyperplane sections for n greater than three k and k greater than two
author: Marcello Bernardara; Enrico Fatighenti; Laurent Manivel
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 8 (2021), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.156
difficulty_reason: The allowed Borel--Bott--Weil theorem supplies a rule for individual twisted-form summands but does not establish the required vanishing range uniformly over all contributing partitions. The author derives the restrictive partition inequalities and classifies the boundary cases, then combines their exact Euler characteristics with the hyperplane conormal formula. Those new calculations identify the first nonzero middle Hodge summand and its dimension without a coprimality assumption.
